newsitem.title: UK: Cambridge Antibody Technology Plc to float at 500p.
newsitem.headline: Cambridge Antibody Technology Plc to float at 500p.

text.p: Cambridge Antibody Technology Group Plc (CAT) said on Wednesday it plans to float on the London Stock Exchange on 25 March at 500p.
The float follows a 38.0 million stg placing which valued the company at 109.0 million stg and was sponsored by Cazenove & Co with Kleinwort Benson as broker.
CAT's chief executive officer David Chiswell said the placing had been well received by investors.
"The response that we have received from institutions has been strong and we are greatly encouraged by the enthusiasm that has been shown for CAT," Chiswell said."

"The flotation marks the start of an exciting new era in our development and we look forward to building on CAT's world-leading technology and developing a portfolio of antibody-based human therapeutic products," he said.
